evidence: A settlement assigning 6 kg to Grandma as peeled unsweetened applesauce, 12 kg to the pantry in twelve labeled 1 kg whole-apple boxes delivered Sunday at 10:00, and 12 kg to unsweetened applesauce in twenty-four 500 g frozen containers passes all checks when PF3 is revealed and cited. A plausible uninformed settlement such as an even 10/10/10 split with ordinary packaging and no pantry commitment fails multiple checks.
